zh: 放弃"空间无限"：弗里德曼方程只管局部几何，管不了整体形状。一个平坦的宇宙可以是有限的三维环面——走出一边就从对面回来，没有边界、没有中心。光绕回来，同一个星系在天上出现好几次；最后散射面和自己相交，CMB 上会有两两匹配的圆。下面的天图和圆都是从一个周期的随机场里实时算出来的。
en: Give up "space is infinite": the Friedmann equation governs only the local geometry, not the global shape. A flat universe can be a finite three-torus — walk out through one side and you come back in from the opposite side; no boundary, no center. Light wraps around, and the same galaxy appears in the sky several times; the last-scattering surface intersects itself, and the CMB shows pairs of matched circles. The sky maps and circles below are computed live from one periodic random field.

zh: ① 有限但无边 模拟
en: ① Finite but without boundary simulated

zh: 一个二维切片：方框是基本胞腔（边长 $L$，以最后散射面的共动半径 $\chi$ 为单位），里面几个星系；大圆是你能看到的范围。拨 $L$，看每个星系在圆里出现多少次。指到（或点一下）任何一个像，看它是谁、离你多远、你看到的是它多久以前的样子。
en: A two-dimensional slice: the box is the fundamental cell (side $L$, in units of the comoving radius $\chi$ of the last-scattering surface), with a few galaxies inside; the big circle is how far you can see. Turn $L$ and watch how many times each galaxy appears inside the circle. Point at (or click) any image to see which galaxy it is, how far away it is, and how long ago you are seeing it.

zh: ② 天上的圈 模拟
en: ② Circles in the sky simulated

zh: CMB 全天图（Sachs–Wolfe 近似：温度 ∝ 周期随机场在最后散射面上的值）。最后散射面被平移 $v$ 后和自己相交于一个圆，圆心在 $\pm\hat v$，角半径 $\alpha = \arccos(|v|/2\chi)$；每一对同色的圆上温度逐点相同。指到（或点一下）一对圆，下面画出沿两个圆的温度。胞腔小时圆对成百上千，默认只画最大的几十对。
en: An all-sky CMB map (Sachs–Wolfe approximation: temperature ∝ the value of the periodic random field on the last-scattering surface). The last-scattering surface translated by $v$ intersects itself in a circle, centered at $\pm\hat v$ with angular radius $\alpha = \arccos(|v|/2\chi)$; on each pair of same-colored circles the temperature agrees point by point. Point at (or click) a pair of circles and the temperature along both circles is drawn below. For a small cell there are hundreds or thousands of pairs; by default only the largest few dozen are drawn.

en: Click to pin a pair, click elsewhere to release. The monopole and dipole have been removed from the map (real CMB maps are treated the same way)

en: No wave longer than $L$ fits in the cell, so when the cell is smaller than the horizon the large-angle power of the CMB is cut off — the quadrupole $C_2$ is suppressed first. Press "Scan" to generate a few random fields for each of a series of $L$ and compute $C_2$ and $C_3$.

zh: 读完你自己的发现之后再看：这个宇宙在说什么
en: Read after you have made your own discoveries: what this universe is saying

zh: 几何和拓扑是两回事。爱因斯坦方程是局部的：它告诉你每一小块空间怎么弯，不告诉你这些小块怎么拼成整体。平坦空间可以拼成无限的 $\mathbb R^3$，也可以拼成有限的三维环面 $T^3$——把一个盒子的对面粘起来——还有另外九种紧致的平坦拼法（Bieberbach：平坦的紧致三维流形一共十种，六种可定向、四种不可定向；加上烟囱、板这样有非紧方向的，共十八种）。正曲率的有限空间更多（庞加莱十二面体空间是其中最出名的，2003 年曾被提出来解释低四极）。弗里德曼方程对它们一视同仁。
en: Geometry and topology are two different things. The Einstein equations are local: they tell you how each small piece of space curves, not how the pieces are assembled into a whole. Flat space can be assembled into the infinite $\mathbb R^3$, or into the finite three-torus $T^3$ — glue the opposite faces of a box together — and there are nine more compact flat assemblies (Bieberbach: there are ten compact flat three-manifolds in all, six orientable and four non-orientable; counting the chimney and the slab, which have non-compact directions, eighteen). Finite spaces of positive curvature are even more numerous (the Poincaré dodecahedral space is the most famous; in 2003 it was proposed to explain the low quadrupole). The Friedmann equation treats them all alike.

zh: 怎么看出来。(1) 鬼像：同一个星系在不同方向、不同距离出现，而且每个像都是它在不同年代的样子——要认出来并不容易，星系会演化。(2) 天上的圈（Cornish、Spergel、Starkman 1998）：最后散射面是半径 $\chi$ 的球，平移 $v$ 的像球和它相交于一个圆，两个圆上的温度逐点相同；$|v| < 2\chi$ 才有。Planck 2015 找遍了所有半径 $> 15°$ 的圆对：没有。这把最小的平移压到了 $\gtrsim 0.94\times 2\chi \approx 1.9\chi$（Planck 2015 XVIII）。(3) 大角度功率被截断：胞腔里没有比 $L$ 长的波，四极先被压低。我们的 CMB 四极确实偏低（只有 ΛCDM 预期的四分之一左右），这曾是拓扑猜想的动机——但匹配圆没找到，这条路基本关上了；低四极大概率只是统计涨落（宇宙方差）。
en: How to tell. (1) Ghost images: the same galaxy appears in different directions and at different distances, and each image shows it at a different age — not easy to recognize, since galaxies evolve. (2) Circles in the sky (Cornish, Spergel, Starkman 1998): the last-scattering surface is a sphere of radius $\chi$; its image translated by $v$ intersects it in a circle, and the temperature on the two circles agrees point by point; this requires $|v| < 2\chi$. Planck 2015 searched every circle pair with radius $> 15°$: none. That pushes the smallest translation to $\gtrsim 0.94\times 2\chi \approx 1.9\chi$ (Planck 2015 XVIII). (3) The large-angle power is cut off: there is no wave longer than $L$ in the cell, so the quadrupole is suppressed first. Our CMB quadrupole is indeed low (only about a quarter of the ΛCDM expectation), which was once the motivation for the topology conjecture — but no matched circles were found, and that road is essentially closed; the low quadrupole is most likely just a statistical fluctuation (cosmic variance).

zh: 本页怎么算。在基本胞腔上生成一个周期的高斯随机场（功率 $\propto k^{-3}$，固定不随 $L$ 变，外加 3° 的平滑），温度取它在半径 $\chi$ 的球上的值（Sachs–Wolfe 近似，$\Delta T/T = \Phi/3$）。周期性不是画上去的：天图里的重复花样、圆对上一模一样的温度曲线、小胞腔时消失的大角度功率，都是从这个场里直接采样出来的。没算的是声学峰（它们在小角度上，和拓扑无关）。
en: How this page computes it. A periodic Gaussian random field is generated on the fundamental cell (power $\propto k^{-3}$, fixed independent of $L$, plus 3° of smoothing), and the temperature is its value on the sphere of radius $\chi$ (Sachs–Wolfe approximation, $\Delta T/T = \Phi/3$). The periodicity is not painted on: the repeating patterns in the sky map, the identical temperature curves on a circle pair, and the large-angle power that disappears for small cells are all sampled directly from this field. What is not computed are the acoustic peaks (they live at small angles and have nothing to do with topology).

zh: 标签：天图、圆、多极功率全是算出来的（模拟）；Planck 的结论引自文献。
en: Labels: the sky map, circles and multipole power are all computed (simulated); Planck's conclusions are quoted from the literature.
